mentioned.quote: Cyber Operations: The ability to significantly enhance or automate sophisticated destructive cyber attacks, including but not limited to discovering novel zero-day exploit chains, developing complex malware
mentioned.note: Listed as a capability requiring 'significant investigation'.

threshold.note: Cyber is in the list of capabilities whose 'exact Capability Threshold and the Required Safeguards are not clear at present' (p.8); 'Instead of prespecifying particular thresholds and safeguards today, we will conduct ongoing assessments'. Thresholds deferred to a future iteration.

response.quote: risks while maintaining our commitment not to train or deploy models unless we have implemented adequate safeguards
response.note: Generic acceptance gate (E3): changelog states this version maintains the commitment; p.2 'not to train or deploy models capable of causing catastrophic harm unless we have implemented safety and security measures that will keep risks below acceptable levels'. Cyber-specific measures are hedged: 'considering the implementation of tiered access controls or phased deployments' (p.8). No cyber threshold (gap).

acc_decider.quote: Board of Directors; (2) approving relevant model training or deployment decisions based on capability and safeguard assessments

acc_unmet.note: Only response for cyber is the generic gate (E4); cyber-specific measures are 'considering' (p.8), so no required response whose failure is addressed.
